q: What is inside the Crispy Rangoon?
why: The Crispy Rangoon is a hand-folded wonton filled with a creamy blend of krab meat and cream cheese, served with sweet chili sauce.

q: Which noodle dish is served with no broth?
why: Stir-Fried Noodles (chicken, beef, veggies, and soba noodles) are served with no broth, unlike the ramen dishes.

q: A guest wants a vegan ramen. Which one features tofu chashu?
why: Vegan Ramen is topped with tofu chashu, scallions, shiitake mushrooms, bok choy, crispy onion, and nori. Curry Ramen uses fried tofu, while Miso and Chicken Shio use meat or egg.

q: Which ramen is topped with naruto?
why: Tokyo Shoyu Ramen comes with chashu, molten egg, seasoned bamboo shoots, spinach, scallions, nori, and naruto.

q: Which classic roll is made with asparagus, avocado, and cucumber?
why: The Evergreen is the vegetarian classic roll with asparagus, avocado, and cucumber. California and Alaska contain crab and smoked salmon respectively.

q: Which classic roll contains smoked salmon, cream cheese, and avocado?
why: The Philadelphia roll is smoked salmon, cream cheese, and avocado. The Alaska is similar but uses cucumber instead of cream cheese.

q: What is the Tiger Eye roll wrapped in before it is deep fried?
why: The Tiger Eye (smoked salmon, cream cheese, shrimp, jalapeno) uses soy paper, then is deep fried and topped with spicy mayo and eel sauce.

q: Which appetizer is tossed in cumin seasoning and finished with lemon juice?
why: Roasted Shishito Peppers are pan-fried and tossed in cumin seasoning, olive oil, salt, and pepper, then topped with sweet lemon juice.

q: What is on top of the Rainbow roll?
why: The Rainbow has crab, avocado, and cucumber inside, topped with tuna, salmon, avocado, and shrimp.

q: Which hot bowl is served over steamed white rice instead of fried rice?
why: The Unadon Bowl has caramelized teriyaki-style eel over steamed white rice. The Teriyaki and Chashu bowls use fried rice, and the Ahi Tuna Bowl is a cold bowl.
